objective: Harden HYDRAGROW controller FSM, transactional execution boundaries, actuator safety, sensor freshness, and recipe lifecycle.

acceptance.criterion: Field-wise ContextDelta merging preserves independent peripheral fields and resolves conflicts via dosing ownership.
Actuator stop/fault paths centralize reset of active actors (dosing, water) and clear ownership flags.
Calibration sampler enforces timeout transition and cleans up pending state on fault/manual transitions.
Sensor data ingestion rejects non-finite/malformed packets and only updates freshness timestamp on valid measurement packets.
Water actor distinguishes success vs failure, records actual execution duration, and avoids false ActiveMixing transitions on timeout.
Safety budget is charged transactionally only for prepared/executable jobs and reflects global hourly limit across pumps.
acceptance.verification: Cargo test safety_budget_executable_tests and safety_budget_scope_tests in hydragrow-controller-core

acceptance.criterion: Dosing volume accounting tracks delivered volume based on actual completed pulse execution.
Water pump hardware commands issue explicit stop and recover cached direction safely.
Same-tick peripheral intent conflicts are resolved deterministically before hardware command emission.
Recipe manager unifies stage calculation, runtime overrides, persistence, and revision reset.
Scheduled water changes plan safe drain/fill volumes clamped to critical tank levels and durations.
In-flight dosing and water jobs snapshot execution parameters (pulse durations, delays, timeouts) resistant to mid-cycle config changes.
Cross-layer FSM regression suite verifies end-to-end recovery, manual mode, emergency shutdown, and partial packet handling.
acceptance.verification: Cargo test cross_layer_fsm_regression_tests and e2e in hydragrow-controller-core
